title: Morpho Bundlers: BadSignatory
likelyCauses: The contract reverted with BadSignatory, a Morpho bundler, callback, permit, transfer, multicall, wrapping, or vault action flow precondition.
The selector identifies the failing contract branch; decoded arguments usually identify the bad account, token, amount, route, nonce, domain, module, or configuration value.
nextSteps: Decode the custom error arguments with the contract ABI or selector catalog.
Check the Morpho Bundlers source precondition named by the error and retry only after changing the transaction inputs or protocol state.
